messages:
Priya: quick ask — we have a candidate panel Tues 11:00am PST. need someone to scribe + a final debrief owner who will submit the form. also confirm recording consent and rubric weighting for this role (senior eng).
Samir: I can scribe but I have a standing 11:05 standup. I can capture the first 5 mins and hand off. @Elena can you take final submit/tiebreaks?
Elena: can do final tiebreak and submit. if Samir starts scribing i'll take over after 11:05. need access to the shared debrief doc: <https://docs.redwood.com/debriefs/xyz>
Maya: candidate explicitly opted OUT of recording in intake. @Priya did we get that logged? if not we'll need to ensure recording is off and scribe-only.
Priya: confirmed — intake flag = no recording. people ops will mark that on the event. please do NOT record. use Debrief form link in the doc to submit scores.
People Ops Bot: Calendar updated — Panel Tues 11:00 PST — recording: OFF. Event link: <https://calendar.redwood.com/e/abc123> (consent flag set to NO)
Aisha: rubric weights for this role: 70% technical, 30% product/soft skills. use `senior-engineer` template.
Jordan: score buckets for reference: 1 = poor, 2 = below expectations, 3 = meets, 4 = exceeds, 5 = outstanding. for tie-break, focus on system design depth + clarity. template: <https://intranet.redwood.com/rubrics/senior-eng>
Samir: ok i'll scribe until 11:05 and add timestamped notes + candidate quotes, then hand to Elena. i'll also drop preliminary numeric scores into the doc (won't submit final).
Priya: awesome — final checklist: 1) recording OFF (people ops flagged), 2) Samir scribe until 11:05, 3) Elena final tiebreak + submit form, 4) Jordan paste rubric into the doc, 5) Aisha rubric weights applied. ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
